finding: The original paper states that images were squarely cropped around the optic nerve head using a shared proportionality criterion. These are dataset-supplied crops, preceding this external evaluation; no new reference-derived crop is applied by the evaluation harness. The paper also describes one image per patient and eye, which does not establish that all selected eyes are independent patients.
conversion_finding: Official parser reads 16 contour points as x/y coordinates minus one; converts them to row/column, interpolates a closed contour and emits a boolean interior mask. The directory converter uses img_as_ubyte to save the boolean foreground as 255 and background as 0. Independent full-cohort coordinate audit supports this mapping for all 348 PNG/TXT pairs, without claiming full interpolated raster equivalence.
